about: Shadow sources for data/stories/S30 (healthtech companies at Web Summit Lisbon 2026), read from the companies' own sites on 12 November 2026, not from websummit.com. STAGED, not merged: the build treats S30 as entirely websummit-only and keeps the folder out; merge when claims are filtered one by one. Not covered: Igloo (site read but no matching self-description quote), Seroton (shop front, no matching text), sheerME (page title only), NeoCannBio, Olá Doutor, Rapidoc, Raras Health (sites not reachable from here).

claims.text: AURIMOD says on its own site that its product VIVO uses auricular vagus nerve stimulation (aVNS) for pain relief without medication.
claims.quote: VIVO setzt durch aurikuläre Vagus-Nerv-Stimulation (aVNS) einen neuen Maßstab in der Schmerzbehandlung

claims.text: Mobile Brain says on its own site that it is a platform that turns spontaneous language into evidence for schools, workplaces and health systems (Portuguese original).
claims.quote: Somos uma plataforma que transforma linguagem espontânea em evidências que apoiam instituições de ensino, ambientes de trabalho e sistemas de saúde

claims.text: Nice Deer says on its own site that it has developed an integrated digital ecosystem for the health insurance industry in Egypt.
claims.quote: Nice Deer Has Developed a Comprehensive Integrated Digital Ecosystem for The Health Insurance Industry in Egypt.

claims.text: Spryt says on its own site that Asa is an AI agent that gets patients to care, predicting patient drop-off.
claims.quote: Meet Asa. The AI agent that gets patients to care.
